scenario: An HR team planning a reduction-in-force (RIF) uploads a full workforce roster CSV. The pipeline parses and groups the roster by work location to determine whether the planned layoffs trigger federal WARN Act notice obligations (50+ affected employees at a single site of employment, or 33%+ of total workforce), then computes the 60-day advance-notice deadline from the planned RIF date and generates a written compliance determination memo.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads the workforce roster CSV and produces a per-site headcount summary (affected employees per physical location) → afrexai-payroll-audit evaluates each site's affected count against WARN Act thresholds and renders a WARN-triggered/exempt determination → temporal-cortex-datetime computes the 60-day advance-notice deadline and certifies whether the planned announcement date satisfies the requirement.
